Remote Autocomplete ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

Load asynchronous suggestions in an autocomplete with reload and cancellation.

Basic usage ​

The example loads options through a local Promise-based function and demonstrates model updates, pausing, and reloading. Requests run entirely within the demo.

Example: basic

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="data-demo">
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="active">启用请求</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamRemoteAutocomplete
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:source="source"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		/>
		<div class="demo-actions">
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" :disabled="!active" @click="reload">
				强制重载
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="control?.cancel()">
				取消请求
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }} {{ error }}</p>
		<pre>{{ value }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose, AsamApiRequest } from '@asam-ui/ui';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteBasicDemoExample' });
interface Item {
	label: string;
	value: string;
	children?: readonly Item[];
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
const value = ref<string | number>('');
const active = ref(true);
const control = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Item>>();
const error = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const items: readonly Item[] = [
	{ label: '准备', value: 'ready' },
	{ label: '进行', value: 'running' }
];
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Item[]> = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return items.filter((item) => item.label.includes(params.text));
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>();
function source(text: string) {
	return factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform: (response) => response,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
}
async function reload() {
	const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
</script>

<style scoped>

}
</style>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import SelectContract from './SelectContract.vue';
import NativeInputContract from './NativeInputContract.vue';
import PopupContract from './PopupContract.vue';
import SourceLifecycleContract from './SourceLifecycleContract.vue';
import PresentationContract from './PresentationContract.vue';
import FormattingContract from './FormattingContract.vue';
import TextCapabilityContract from './TextCapabilityContract.vue';
import ValidationContract from './ValidationContract.vue';
import InputInstanceContract from './InputInstanceContract.vue';
import OfficialInputContract from './OfficialInputContract.vue';
import OfficialLayoutContract from './OfficialLayoutContract.vue';
import OfficialSuggestionContract from './OfficialSuggestionContract.vue';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteNativeDataDemo' });
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import QueryContract from './QueryContract.vue';
const showQueryContract = ref(false);
const showSelectContract = ref(false);
const showNativeInputContract = ref(false);
const showPopupContract = ref(false);
const showSourceLifecycleContract = ref(false);
const showPresentationContract = ref(false);
const showFormattingContract = ref(false);
const showTextCapabilityContract = ref(false);
const showValidationContract = ref(false);
const showInputInstanceContract = ref(false);
const showOfficialInputContract = ref(false);
const showOfficialLayoutContract = ref(false);
const showOfficialSuggestionContract = ref(false);
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteEmits,
	AsamOption,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps,
	AsamDataError
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Member {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
const value = ref<string | number>('');
const active = ref(true);
const failure = ref(false);
const requests = ref(0);
const control = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Member>>();
const selected = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteEmits<string, Member>['select'][0]>();
const instance = ref<object>({});
const message = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const lastKey = ref('');
const methodResult = ref('');
const events = ref<{ name: string; payload: unknown }[]>([]);
const showArrow = ref<boolean | undefined>(false);
const offset = ref(16);
function recordKey(event: Event | KeyboardEvent): void {
	lastKey.value = event instanceof KeyboardEvent ? event.key : '';
	recordDom('keydown', event);
}
function recordValue(name: string, value: string | number): void {
	events.value.push({ name, payload: value });
}
function recordDom(name: string, event: Event): void {
	events.value.push({
		name,
		payload: {
			type: event.type,
			constructor: event.constructor.name,
			trusted: event.isTrusted,
			key: event instanceof KeyboardEvent ? event.key : undefined,
			data: event instanceof CompositionEvent ? event.data : undefined
		}
	});
}
function recordSelect(option: AsamRemoteAutocompleteEmits<string, Member>['select'][0]): void {
	selected.value = option;
	events.value.push({ name: 'select', payload: option });
}
function recordError(error: AsamDataError): void {
	message.value = error.message;
	events.value.push({ name: 'error', payload: { kind: error.kind, message: error.message } });
}
function recordSuccess(options: readonly AsamOption<string, Member>[]): void {
	message.value = '';
	events.value.push({ name: 'success', payload: options });
}
const members: readonly Member[] = [
	{ id: 1, label: 'Alpha', value: 'alpha' },
	{ id: 2, label: 'Beta', value: 'beta' }
];
const popperOptions = computed<AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>['popperOptions']>(
	() => ({
		modifiers: [{ name: 'offset', options: { offset: [0, offset.value] } }]
	})
);
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Member[]> = async (query, context) => {
	requests.value += 1;
	await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 180));
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示接口失败');
	return members.filter((member) =>
		member.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.text.toLowerCase())
	);
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const transform = (response: readonly Member[]) => response;
function source(text: string) {
	return factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
}
async function reload() {
	result.value = (await control.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function loadAll() {
	methodResult.value = 'getData:pending';
	await control.value?.getData('');
	methodResult.value = 'getData:done';
}
async function selectFirst() {
	const first = control.value?.suggestions[0];
	if (!first) return;
	await control.value?.handleSelect(first);
	methodResult.value = 'handleSelect:done';
}
async function enter() {
	await control.value?.handleKeyEnter();
	methodResult.value = 'handleKeyEnter:done';
}
function inspect() {
	const current = control.value;
	instance.value = {
		highlightedIndex: current?.highlightedIndex,
		activated: current?.activated,
		loading: current?.loading,
		suggestions: current?.suggestions,
		inputReady: !!current?.inputRef,
		popperReady: !!current?.popperRef
	};
}

function keepHeaderFocus(event: MouseEvent) {
	if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.closest('[role=button]'))
		event.preventDefault();
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.autocomplete-demo {
	--asam-layout-control-width: 100%;

	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

.actions {
	display: flex;

	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
	align-items: center;
}

.panel-caption {

}

.instance-controls {

}

.instance-controls .actions {

	z-index: 2;

	max-width: 80vw;

	background: var(--el-bg-color);
}

pre {
	max-height: 32rem;
	overflow: auto;
	white-space: pre-wrap;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

	margin-block: 16px;

vue
<template>
	<section data-testid="autocomplete-query-contract">
		<h3>建议查询与键盘设置</h3>
		<div>
			<label>
				<span>建议数量</span>
				<AsamSelect v-model="limitControl" aria-label="建议数量">
					<AsamOption value="__asam_example_unconfigured__" :label="'原默认'">
						原默认
					</AsamOption>
					<AsamOption :value="1" :label="'一项'">一项</AsamOption>
					<AsamOption :value="2" :label="'两项'">两项</AsamOption>
				</AsamSelect>
			</label>
			<label>
				<span>聚焦查询</span>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteEmits,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Member {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	value: string;
	disabled?: boolean;
}
const members: readonly Member[] = [
	{ id: 1, label: 'Alpha', value: 'alpha' },
	{ id: 2, label: 'Beta', value: 'beta' },
	{ id: 3, label: '禁用', value: 'disabled', disabled: true },
	{ id: 4, label: 'Delta', value: 'delta' }
];
const control = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Member>>();
const model = ref<string | number>('');
const mounted = ref(true);
const detachedReferences = ref<{
	controlPresent: boolean;
	inputReady: boolean;
	popperReady: boolean;
}>();
const limit = ref<number | undefined>();
const trigger = ref<boolean | undefined>();
const highlightFirst = ref<boolean | undefined>();
const loop = ref<boolean | undefined>();
const unmatched = ref<boolean | undefined>();
const hideLoading = ref<boolean | undefined>();
const debounce = ref<number | undefined>();
const hold = ref(false);
const pendingCount = ref(0);
const calls = ref<string[]>([]);
const selected = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteEmits<string, Member>['select'][0][]>([]);
const methodResult = ref('');
const guardErrors = ref<{ limit: string; message: string }[]>([]);
const pending = new Set<() => void>();
function release(): void {
	for (const done of pending) done();
	pending.clear();
	pendingCount.value = 0;
}
const api: AsamApiRequest<{ text: string }, readonly Member[]> = async (query, context) => {
	calls.value.push(query.text);
	if (hold.value) {
		await new Promise<void>((done) => {
			pending.add(done);
			pendingCount.value = pending.size;
		});
	}
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return members.filter((member) =>
		member.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.text.toLowerCase())
	);
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const source = (text: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform: (response) => response,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value', disabled: 'disabled' }
	});
async function load(): Promise<void> {
	methodResult.value = 'getData:pending';
	await control.value?.getData('');
	methodResult.value = 'getData:done';
}
async function enter(): Promise<void> {
	methodResult.value = 'enter:pending';
	await control.value?.handleKeyEnter();
	methodResult.value = 'enter:done';
}
async function invalidLimits(): Promise<void> {
	control.value?.close();
	methodResult.value = 'guard:pending';
	for (const invalid of [0, -1, 1.5, NaN, Infinity]) {
		limit.value = invalid;
		await nextTick();
		try {
			await control.value?.getData('');
		} catch (error) {
			guardErrors.value.push({
				limit: String(invalid),
				message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
			});
		}
	}
	limit.value = undefined;
	await nextTick();
	await control.value?.getData('');
	control.value?.close();
	methodResult.value = 'guard:done';
}
async function unmountInput(): Promise<void> {
	const saved = control.value;
	mounted.value = false;
	await nextTick();
	detachedReferences.value = {
		controlPresent: !!control.value,
		inputReady: !!saved?.inputRef,
		popperReady: !!saved?.popperRef
	};
}
const snapshot = computed(() => ({
	mounted: mounted.value,
	detachedReferences: detachedReferences.value,
	model: model.value,
	calls: calls.value,
	selected: selected.value,
	pending: pendingCount.value,
	methodResult: methodResult.value,
	guardErrors: guardErrors.value,
	index: control.value?.highlightedIndex,
	loading: control.value?.loading,
	activated: control.value?.activated,
	suggestions: control.value?.suggestions,
	inputReady: !!control.value?.inputRef,
	popperReady: !!control.value?.popperRef
}));
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	control.value?.cancel();
	release();
});

const limitControl = computed({
	get: () => limit.value ?? '__asam_example_unconfigured__',
	set: (value: unknown) => {
		limit.value =
			value === '__asam_example_unconfigured__' ? undefined : (value as typeof limit.value);
	}
});
const triggerControl = computed({
	get: () => trigger.value ?? '__asam_example_unconfigured__',
	set: (value: unknown) => {
		trigger.value =
			value === '__asam_example_unconfigured__' ? undefined : (value as typeof trigger.value);
	}
});
const highlightFirstControl = computed({
	get: () => highlightFirst.value ?? '__asam_example_unconfigured__',
	set: (value: unknown) => {
		highlightFirst.value =
			value === '__asam_example_unconfigured__'
				? undefined
				: (value as typeof highlightFirst.value);
	}
});
const loopControl = computed({
	get: () => loop.value ?? '__asam_example_unconfigured__',
	set: (value: unknown) => {
		loop.value =
			value === '__asam_example_unconfigured__' ? undefined : (value as typeof loop.value);
	}
});
const unmatchedControl = computed({
	get: () => unmatched.value ?? '__asam_example_unconfigured__',
	set: (value: unknown) => {
		unmatched.value =
			value === '__asam_example_unconfigured__'
				? undefined
				: (value as typeof unmatched.value);
	}
});
const hideLoadingControl = computed({
	get: () => hideLoading.value ?? '__asam_example_unconfigured__',
	set: (value: unknown) => {
		hideLoading.value =
			value === '__asam_example_unconfigured__'
				? undefined
				: (value as typeof hideLoading.value);
	}
});
const debounceControl = computed({
	get: () => debounce.value ?? '__asam_example_unconfigured__',
	set: (value: unknown) => {
		debounce.value =
			value === '__asam_example_unconfigured__'
				? undefined
				: (value as typeof debounce.value);
	}
});

function keepHeaderFocus(event: MouseEvent) {
	if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.closest('[role=button]'))
		event.preventDefault();
}
</script>

<template>
	<AsamCollapse data-testid="select-union-contract">
		<AsamCollapseItem name="auxiliary-content">
			<template #title><span>匹配建议与未匹配 Enter</span></template>
			<div class="demo-slot-layout">
				<div class="demo-slot-actions">
					<AsamButton
						type="default"
						native-type="button"
						:disabled="busy"
						@click="runMatched"
					>
						验证六种匹配来源
					</AsamButton>
					<AsamButton
						type="default"
						native-type="button"
						:disabled="busy"
						@click="runUnmatched"
					>
						验证实例未匹配 Enter
					</AsamButton>
					<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="prepareKeyboard">
						准备实际键盘未匹配 Enter
					</AsamButton>

				<AsamAutocomplete
					v-if="mounted && mode !== 'remote'"
					:key="mode"
					ref="control"
					v-model="model"
					:value-key="mode === 'static' ? 'value' : 'caption'"
					v-bind="{
						...(mode === 'static' ? { options: [option] } : { fetchSuggestions }),
						...(policy === undefined ? {} : { selectWhenUnmatched: policy })
					}"
					:debounce="0"
					:teleported="false"
					aria-label="选择载荷契约"
					@select="recordSelection"
				>
					<template #default="{ item }">
						<span>{{ 'raw' in item ? item.raw.id : item.code }}</span>
					</template>
				</AsamAutocomplete>
				<AsamRemoteAutocomplete
					v-else-if="mounted"
					ref="control"
					v-model="model"
					:source="remoteSource"
					:debounce="0"
					:teleported="false"
					aria-label="选择载荷契约"
					@select="recordSelection"
					@success="remoteOptions = $event"
				/>
				<pre data-testid="select-union-result">{{
					JSON.stringify({ busy, observations, selected })
				}}</pre>

		</AsamCollapseItem>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, nextTick, ref, shallowRef, toRaw } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamAutocomplete,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamAutocompleteExpose,
	AsamAutocompleteFetchSuggestions,
	AsamOption
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Member {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Native {
	code: number;
	caption: string;
	value: string;
}
type Mode = 'static' | 'array' | 'sync' | 'callback' | 'promise' | 'remote' | 'empty';
type Selection = Native | AsamOption<string, Member> | { value: string | number };
const member: Member = { id: 7, name: 'Alpha', value: 'alpha' };
const option: AsamOption<string, Member> = { label: 'Alpha', value: 'alpha', raw: member };
const native: Native = { code: 7, caption: 'Alpha', value: 'alpha' };
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const remoteSource = (query: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api: async () => [member],
		params: { query },
		transform: (response) => response,
		fieldNames: { label: 'name', value: 'value' }
	});
const mode = ref<Mode>('static');
const mounted = ref(false);
const busy = ref(false);
const model = ref<string | number>('');
const policy = ref<boolean>();
const control = shallowRef<AsamAutocompleteExpose<Native | AsamOption<string, Member>>>();
const selected = shallowRef<Selection[]>([]);
const remoteOptions = shallowRef<readonly AsamOption<string, Member>[]>([]);
const observations = ref<object[]>([]);
const fetchSuggestions = computed<AsamAutocompleteFetchSuggestions<Native>>(() => {
	if (mode.value === 'array') return [native];
	if (mode.value === 'sync') return () => [native];
	if (mode.value === 'callback') return (_query, callback) => callback([native]);
	if (mode.value === 'promise') return async () => [native];
	return [];
});
function recordSelection(item: Selection) {
	selected.value = [...selected.value, item];
}
async function mount(next: Mode, value: string | number = '') {
	mounted.value = false;
	await nextTick();
	mode.value = next;
	model.value = value;
	mounted.value = true;
	await nextTick();
}
async function runMatched() {
	busy.value = true;
	observations.value = [];
	for (const next of ['static', 'array', 'sync', 'callback', 'promise', 'remote'] as const) {
		await mount(next);
		await control.value?.getData('Alpha');
		const suggestion = control.value?.suggestions[0];
		if (!suggestion) {
			observations.value.push({ phase: next, missingSuggestion: true });
			continue;
		}
		await control.value?.handleSelect(suggestion);
		const item = selected.value.at(-1);
		observations.value.push({
			phase: next,
			sameSuggestionObject: item === suggestion,
			sameOriginalObject:
				item &&
				toRaw(item) ===
					(next === 'remote'
						? toRaw(remoteOptions.value[0])
						: next === 'static'
							? option
							: native),
			completeMatchedPayload:
				item &&
				('raw' in item
					? item.raw.id === 7 &&
						item.raw.name === 'Alpha' &&
						item.raw.value === 'alpha' &&
						item.label === 'Alpha' &&
						toRaw(item.raw) ===
							(next === 'remote' ? toRaw(remoteOptions.value[0]?.raw) : member)
					: 'code' in item && item.code === 7 && item.caption === 'Alpha'),
			value: item?.value,
			suggestionsStillComplete: control.value?.suggestions.every(
				(item) => 'raw' in item || 'code' in item
			)
		});
	}
	busy.value = false;
}
async function runUnmatched() {
	busy.value = true;
	observations.value = [];
	for (const value of ['Unmatched', 42]) {
		for (const nextPolicy of [undefined, false, true]) {
			policy.value = nextPolicy;
			await mount('empty', value);
			await control.value?.getData('missing');
			const before = selected.value.length;
			await control.value?.handleKeyEnter();
			observations.value.push({
				phase: 'instance-unmatched',
				model: value,
				policy: nextPolicy ?? 'undefined',
				added: selected.value.length - before,
				item: selected.value.length > before ? selected.value.at(-1) : null,
				suggestionCount: control.value?.suggestions.length
			});
		}
	}
	busy.value = false;
}
async function prepareKeyboard() {
	policy.value = true;
	await mount('empty', 'Keyboard unmatched');
	await control.value?.getData('missing');
	control.value?.focus();
}
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { computed, nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamApiRequest, AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Member {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
type Props = AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>;
type Configuration = Pick<
	Props,
	| 'id'
	| 'ariaLabel'
	| 'tabindex'
	| 'form'
	| 'name'
	| 'autocomplete'
	| 'inputmode'
	| 'placeholder'
	| 'minlength'
	| 'maxlength'
	| 'min'
	| 'max'
	| 'step'
	| 'autofocus'
	| 'rows'
	| 'resize'
>;
const configurations = {
	explicit: {
		id: 'data009-native-input',
		ariaLabel: '原生输入契约',
		tabindex: 3,
		form: 'data009-input-owner',
		name: 'native-query',
		autocomplete: 'on',
		inputmode: 'search',
		placeholder: 'Input contract',
		minlength: 2,
		maxlength: 8,
		min: 2,
		max: 10,
		step: 2,
		autofocus: true,
		rows: 4,
		resize: 'none'
	},
	omitted: {}
} satisfies Record<string, Configuration>;
const mode = ref<'explicit' | 'omitted'>('explicit');
const type = ref<'text' | 'password' | 'number' | 'textarea'>('text');
const model = ref<string | number>('seed');
const readonly = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const mounted = ref(true);
const inputs = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
const updates = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
const queries = ref<string[]>([]);
const configuration = computed(() => configurations[mode.value]);
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Member[]> = async (query, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	queries.value.push(query.text);
	return [{ id: 7, label: query.text, value: query.text }];
};
const source = (text: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform: (items) => items,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
async function remount() {
	mounted.value = false;
	await nextTick();
	mounted.value = true;
}
async function mountNumber() {
	mounted.value = false;
	await nextTick();
	model.value = 4;
	type.value = 'number';
	mounted.value = true;
}

<template>
	<section data-testid="autocomplete-popup-case">
		<label for="autocomplete-popup-scenario">建议浮层配置</label>
		<AsamSelect id="autocomplete-popup-scenario" v-model="scenario">
			<AsamOption
				v-for="item in scenarios"
				:key="item.value"
				:value="item.value"
				:label="item.label"
			>
				{{ item.label }}
			</AsamOption>
		</AsamSelect>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="open">打开配置后的建议</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton
			type="default"
			v-if="scenario === 'role'"
			native-type="button"
			@click="liveRole = 'group'"
		>
			切换已挂载输入角色
		</AsamButton>
		<div id="autocomplete-popup-host" ref="host" data-testid="autocomplete-popup-host" />
		<div class="popup-input-area">
			<AsamRemoteAutocomplete
				v-if="mounted"
				:key="generation"
				ref="control"
				v-model="value"
				:source="source"
				:debounce="0"
				v-bind="configuration"
				aria-label="浮层协议成员"
			>
				<template #header>
					<span data-testid="autocomplete-popup-header">配置后的建议</span>
				</template>
				<template #default="{ item }">
					<span>{{ item.label }} · {{ item.raw.id }}</span>
				</template>
			</AsamRemoteAutocomplete>
		</div>
		<p class="example-paragraph">当前配置：{{ scenario }}；模型：{{ value }}</p>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps, AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Member {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	value: string;
}
const scenarios = [
	{ value: 'default', label: '省略配置' },
	...['top', 'top-start', 'top-end', 'bottom', 'bottom-start', 'bottom-end'].map((value) => ({
		value,
		label: value
	})),
	{ value: 'style-object', label: '自定义类与对象样式' },
	{ value: 'style-string', label: '字符串样式' },
	{ value: 'style-array', label: '组合样式' },
	{ value: 'local', label: '就地显示，忽略附加目标' },
	{ value: 'selector', label: '传送到指定选择器' },
	{ value: 'element', label: '传送到实际元素' },
	{ value: 'fit', label: '固定为输入宽度' },
	{ value: 'min', label: '输入宽度作为最小宽度' },
	{ value: 'role', label: '自定义输入角色' }
];
const scenario = ref('default');
const liveRole = ref('searchbox');
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
const value = ref('');
const mounted = ref(true);
const generation = ref(0);
const control = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Member>>();
const member = {
	id: 7,
	value: 'alpha',
	name: 'Alpha member with a deliberately long suggestion label for popup width comparison'
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const source: AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>['source'] = (text) =>
	factory.api({
		api: async (_params, context) => {
			context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			return [member];
		},
		params: { text },
		transform: (items) => items,
		fieldNames: { label: 'name', value: 'value' }
	});
const configuration = computed((): Partial<AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>> => {
	if (
		['top', 'top-start', 'top-end', 'bottom', 'bottom-start', 'bottom-end'].includes(
			scenario.value
		)
	)
		return {
			placement: scenario.value as AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>['placement']
		};
	if (scenario.value === 'style-object')
		return {
			popperClass: 'data009-popup-custom',
			popperStyle: { backgroundColor: 'rgb(11, 22, 33)', borderWidth: '3px' }
		};
	if (scenario.value === 'style-string')
		return { popperStyle: 'background-color: rgb(22, 33, 44); border-width: 4px;' };
	if (scenario.value === 'style-array')
		return { popperStyle: [{ backgroundColor: 'rgb(33, 44, 55)' }, { borderWidth: '5px' }] };
	if (scenario.value === 'local')
		return { teleported: false, appendTo: '#autocomplete-popup-host' };
	if (scenario.value === 'selector')
		return { teleported: true, appendTo: '#autocomplete-popup-host' };
	if (scenario.value === 'element') return { teleported: true, appendTo: host.value };
	if (scenario.value === 'fit') return { fitInputWidth: true };
	if (scenario.value === 'min') return { fitInputWidth: false };
	if (scenario.value === 'role') return { containerRole: liveRole.value };
	return {};
});
async function open() {
	liveRole.value = 'searchbox';
	control.value?.close();
	mounted.value = false;
	await nextTick();
	value.value = '';
	generation.value++;
	mounted.value = true;
	await nextTick();
	control.value?.focus();
	await control.value?.getData('');
}
</script>

		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reload()">省略重载选项</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reload(false)">普通重载</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reload(true)">
			强制重载来源
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="control?.cancel()">
			取消当前来源
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="selectFirst">
			选择完整首项
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="hold = true">
			持有后续响应
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="hold = false">
			即时后续响应
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="failure = true">
			后续接口失败
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="failure = false">
			恢复接口
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="release(false)">
			完成最早持有响应
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="release(true)">
			拒绝最早持有响应
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="mountControl">
			重新挂载来源
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="detach">卸载来源</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="reloadDetached">
			读取卸载后的重载结果
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="savedControl?.cancel()">
			取消卸载后的来源

		<div ref="host" class="source-control-host" />

		}}</pre>
	</section>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, createApp, h, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamInput,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions,
	provideAsamData
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamDataProvider,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps,
	AsamRequestContext,
	AsamReloadResult
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Member {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
interface Call {
	kind: string;
	text: string;
	requestId: number;
	aborted: boolean;
	url?: string;
	method?: string;
}
interface Deferred {
	resolve: (items: readonly Member[]) => void;
	reject: (reason: Error) => void;
	call: Call;
}
const kind = ref<'api' | 'request'>('api');
const activeMode = ref('omitted');
const active = computed(() =>
	activeMode.value === 'omitted' ? undefined : activeMode.value === 'true'
);
const draft = ref('Alpha');
const model = ref<string | number>('retained-model');
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
const control = shallowRef<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Member>>();
const calls = ref<Call[]>([]);
const results = ref<unknown[]>([]);
const successes = ref<unknown[]>([]);
const errors = ref<unknown[]>([]);
const hold = ref(false);
const failure = ref(false);
const deferred: Deferred[] = [];
const pendingCount = ref(0);
const mounted = ref(false);
const lastAction = ref('unloaded');
let app: App | undefined;
let savedControl: AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Member> | undefined;
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const fields = { label: 'name', value: 'value' } as const;
const cache = { ttlMs: 60000 };
function members(text: string): readonly Member[] {
	return [{ id: 7, name: text, value: text.toLowerCase() }];
}
async function load(call: Call, context: AsamRequestContext): Promise<readonly Member[]> {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	calls.value.push(call);
	const recorded = calls.value.at(-1)!;
	context.signal.addEventListener(
		'abort',
		() => {
			recorded.aborted = true;
		},
		{ once: true }
	);
	if (hold.value)
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			deferred.push({ resolve, reject, call: recorded });
			pendingCount.value = deferred.length;
		});
	if (failure.value) throw new Error('source lifecycle API failure');
	return members(call.text);
}
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Member[]> = (params, context) =>
	load({ kind: 'api', text: params.text, requestId: context.requestId, aborted: false }, context);
const transformApi = (items: readonly Member[]) => items;
function isMember(value: unknown): value is Member {
	return (
		typeof value === 'object' &&
		value !== null &&
		'id' in value &&
		typeof value.id === 'number' &&
		'name' in value &&
		typeof value.name === 'string' &&
		'value' in value &&
		typeof value.value === 'string'
	);
}
function transformRequest(response: unknown): readonly Member[] {
	if (!Array.isArray(response) || !response.every(isMember))
		throw new Error('invalid member response');
	return response;
}
const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
	request: async (config, context) => {
		const text = config.params?.text;
		if (typeof text !== 'string')
			throw new Error('query must reach the real request parameters');
		return load(
			{
				kind: 'request',
				text,
				requestId: context.requestId,
				aborted: false,
				url: config.url,
				...(config.method === undefined ? {} : { method: config.method })
			},
			context
		);
	}
};
const source: AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>['source'] = (text) =>
	kind.value === 'api'
		? factory.api({ api, params: { text }, transform: transformApi, fieldNames: fields, cache })
		: factory.request({
				request: { url: '/data009/autocomplete-members', params: { text } },
				transform: transformRequest,
				fieldNames: fields,
				cache
			});
const TypedRemote = AsamRemoteAutocomplete<string, Member>;
const snapshot = computed(() => ({
	kind: kind.value,
	active: active.value ?? 'omitted',
	mounted: mounted.value,
	detachedSuggestions: !mounted.value ? (savedControl?.suggestions ?? []) : undefined,
	draft: draft.value,
	model: model.value,
	calls: calls.value,
	pending: pendingCount.value,
	loading: control.value?.loading ?? false,
	suggestions: control.value?.suggestions ?? [],
	lastAction: lastAction.value,
	results: results.value,
	successes: successes.value,
	errors: errors.value
}));
async function mountControl() {
	detach();
	await nextTick();
	if (!host.value) return;
	app = createApp({
		render: () =>
			h(TypedRemote, {
				ref: control,
				modelValue: model.value,
				source,
				...(active.value === undefined ? {} : { active: active.value }),
				debounce: 0,
				triggerOnFocus: false,
				ariaLabel: '来源生命周期成员',
				'onUpdate:modelValue': (value: string | number) => {
					model.value = value;
				},
				onSuccess: (items: readonly AsamOption<string, Member>[]) => {
					successes.value.push(items);
				},
				onError: (error: unknown) => {
					errors.value.push(error);
				}
			})
	});
	provideAsamData(app, provider, { scope: 'data009-autocomplete-source-lifecycle' });
	app.mount(host.value);
	mounted.value = true;
	lastAction.value = 'mounted';
}
function detach() {
	if (control.value) savedControl = control.value;
	app?.unmount();
	app = undefined;
	control.value = undefined;
	mounted.value = false;
	lastAction.value = 'unmounted';
}
async function getData() {
	lastAction.value = 'query-pending';
	await control.value?.getData(draft.value);
	lastAction.value = 'query-settled';
}
async function reload(force?: boolean) {
	lastAction.value = 'reload-pending';
	const result: AsamReloadResult<readonly AsamOption<string, Member>[]> | undefined =
		await control.value?.reload(force === undefined ? undefined : { force });
	results.value.push(result ?? { status: 'detached' });
	lastAction.value = 'reload-settled';
}
async function reloadDetached() {
	const result = await savedControl?.reload({ force: true });
	results.value.push(result ?? { status: 'missing-saved-control' });
}
async function selectFirst() {
	const item = control.value?.suggestions[0];
	if (item) await control.value?.handleSelect(item);
}
function release(reject: boolean) {
	const next = deferred.shift();
	pendingCount.value = deferred.length;
	if (!next) return;
	if (reject) next.reject(new Error('held source lifecycle failure'));
	else next.resolve(members(next.call.text));
}
onMounted(mountControl);
onBeforeUnmount(detach);
</script>

<style scoped>

	margin-block: 24px;
}
</style>

		</div>
		<div ref="host" class="presentation-host" />
		<pre data-testid="autocomplete-presentation-result">{{
			JSON.stringify({
				model,
				inputs,
				updates,
				clears,
				requests,
				suggestions,
				size,
				providerSize,
				clearable,
				icons,

				readonly,
				disabled

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, createApp, h, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamConfigProvider,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions,
	provideAsamData
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import type {
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamControlSize,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Member {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
type Props = AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>;
const host = ref<HTMLDivElement>();
const control = shallowRef<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Member>>();
const model = ref<string | number>('Alpha');
const size = ref<AsamControlSize | 'omitted'>('omitted');
const providerSize = ref<AsamControlSize>('big');
const clearable = ref<'omitted' | 'true' | 'false'>('omitted');
const icons = ref<'omitted' | 'component' | 'string'>('omitted');
const styleMode = ref<'omitted' | 'object' | 'string' | 'array'>('omitted');
const readonly = ref(false),
	disabled = ref(false);
const inputs = ref<(string | number)[]>([]),
	updates = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
const clears = ref(0),
	requests = ref<string[]>([]);
const suggestions = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Member>['suggestions']>([]);
const icon = (name: string, path: string) => () =>
	h('svg', { viewBox: '0 0 16 16', 'data-presentation-icon': name, 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, [
		h('path', { d: path, fill: 'currentColor' })
	]);

<script lang="ts" setup>
import {
	computed,
	createApp,
	h,
	nextTick,
	onBeforeUnmount,
	onMounted,
	reactive,
	ref,
	shallowRef
} from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamButton,
	AsamBaseForm,
	AsamFormItem,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions,
	provideAsamData
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import type {
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamFormItemExpose,
	AsamFormItemProps,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Member {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
type Props = AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>;
const host = ref<HTMLDivElement>();
const item = shallowRef<AsamFormItemExpose>();
const fields = reactive({ value: 'Seed' });
const mode = ref<'omitted' | 'true' | 'false'>('omitted');
const lazy = ref<'omitted' | 'lazy'>('omitted');
const inputs = ref<(string | number)[]>([]),
	updates = ref<(string | number)[]>([]),
	changes = ref<(string | number)[]>([]),
	validations = ref<string[]>([]);
const validateEvents = ref<{ property: unknown; valid: boolean; message: string }[]>([]);
type ItemRule = Exclude<AsamFormItemProps['rules'], readonly unknown[] | undefined>;
const rule: ItemRule = {
	trigger: ['change', 'blur'],
	validator: (_rule, value, callback) => {
		validations.value.push(String(value));
		callback(String(value).includes('!') ? new Error('建议值禁止感叹号') : undefined);
	}
};
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Member[]> = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return [{ id: 7, name: params.text, value: params.text.toLowerCase() }];
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const transform = (items: readonly Member[]) => items;
const source = (text: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform,
		fieldNames: { label: 'name', value: 'value' }
	});

	source,

let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	app = createApp({

						h(TypedRemote, {
							...configuration.value,
							'onUpdate:modelValue': (value: string | number) => {
								fields.value = String(value);
								updates.value.push(value);
							},
							onInput: (value: string | number) => inputs.value.push(value),
							onChange: (value: string | number) => changes.value.push(value)
						})
					)
			)
	});
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'data009-autocomplete-validation' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
async function reset() {
	fields.value = 'Seed';
	await nextTick();
	await nextTick();
	// Finish the queued blur validation before starting this measurement window.
	await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
	await nextTick();
	item.value?.clearValidate();
	validations.value = [];
	validateEvents.value = [];
	inputs.value = [];
	updates.value = [];
	changes.value = [];
}

	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,

	provideAsamData

	{ value: 'cooking', link: 'https://github.com/ElemeFE/cooking' },
	{ value: 'mint-ui', link: 'https://github.com/ElemeFE/mint-ui' },
	{ value: 'vuex', link: 'https://github.com/vuejs/vuex' },
	{ value: 'vue-router', link: 'https://github.com/vuejs/vue-router' },
	{ value: 'babel', link: 'https://github.com/babel/babel' }
];
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
const models = ref<Record<CaseId, string | number>>({
	'basic-focus': '',
	'basic-input': '',
	template: '',
	remote: '',
	'loading-ring': '',
	'loading-dots': '',
	header: '',
	footer: ''
});
const loadingModel = ref<string | number>('');
const queries = ref<{ control: CaseId; query: string; results: readonly LinkItem[] }[]>([]);
const selections = ref<{ control: CaseId; item: Selection }[]>([]);
const iconClicks = ref<{ type: string; nativeMouse: boolean }[]>([]);
const footerClears = ref(0);
const pending = ref<CaseId[]>([]);
const footer = shallowRef<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, LinkItem>>();
const releases = new Map<CaseId, () => void>();
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, LinkItem>();
const TypedRemote = AsamRemoteAutocomplete<string, LinkItem>;
const isLoadingCase = (name: CaseId) => name === 'loading-ring' || name === 'loading-dots';
const model = (name: CaseId) => (isLoadingCase(name) ? loadingModel.value : models.value[name]);
const setModel = (name: CaseId, value: string | number) => {
	if (isLoadingCase(name)) loadingModel.value = value;
	else models.value[name] = value;
};
const api: AsamApiRequest<{ control: CaseId; query: string }, readonly LinkItem[]> = async (
	params: { control: CaseId; query: string },
	context
) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	const results = links.filter((item) =>
		item.value.toLowerCase().startsWith(params.query.toLowerCase())
	);
	queries.value.push({ ...params, results });
	if (isLoadingCase(params.control)) {
		pending.value.push(params.control);
		try {
			await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => reject(context.signal.reason);
				context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				releases.set(params.control, () => {
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					resolve();
				});
			});
		} finally {
			pending.value = pending.value.filter((name) => name !== params.control);
			releases.delete(params.control);
		}
	} else if (
		params.control === 'remote' ||
		params.control === 'header' ||
		params.control === 'footer'
	) {
		await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));
	}
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return results;
};
const source = (control: CaseId, query: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { control, query },
		transform: (rows) => rows,
		fieldNames: { label: 'value', value: 'value' }
	});
const cases = names.map((name) => ({ name, source: (query: string) => source(name, query) }));
const circle = () =>
	h('svg', { class: 'circular', viewBox: '0 0 50 50', 'data-testid': 'official-ring-loader' }, [
		h('circle', { class: 'path', cx: 25, cy: 25, r: 20, fill: 'none' })
	]);
const dots = () =>
	h(
		AsamIcon,
		{ class: 'is-loading', 'data-testid': 'official-dots-loader' },
		{
			default: () =>
				h('svg', { class: 'circular', viewBox: '0 0 20 20' }, [
					h(
						'g',
						{
							class: 'path2 loading-path',
							'stroke-width': 0,
							style: { animation: 'none', stroke: 'none' }
						},
						['dot1', 'dot2', 'dot4', 'dot3'].map((name) =>
							h('circle', { r: 3.375, class: name, rx: 0, ry: 0 })
						)
					)
				])
		}
	);
async function clearFooter() {
	models.value.footer = '';
	footerClears.value++;
	await nextTick();
	await footer.value?.getData('');
}
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	app = createApp({
		render: () =>
			h(
				'div',
				{ class: 'suggestion-grid' },
				cases.map(({ name, source: caseSource }) =>
					h('article', { 'data-testid': 'official-suggestion-' + name }, [
						h('h3', name),
						...(isLoadingCase(name)
							? [
									h(
										AsamButton,
										{
											type: 'default',
											nativeType: 'button',
											onMousedown: (event: MouseEvent) =>
												event.preventDefault(),
											onClick: () => releases.get(name)?.()
										},
										{ default: () => '完成官方加载 ' + name }
									)
								]
							: []),
						h(
							TypedRemote,
							{
								...(name === 'footer' ? { ref: footer } : {}),
								modelValue: model(name),
								'onUpdate:modelValue': (value: string | number) =>
									setModel(name, value),
								source: caseSource,
								ariaLabel: '官方建议 ' + name,
								placeholder:
									name === 'basic-focus' || name === 'basic-input'
										? '请输入内容'
										: '输入查询内容',
								clearable: name === 'basic-focus' || name === 'basic-input',
								teleported: false,
								debounce: 0,
								...(name === 'basic-input' ? { triggerOnFocus: false } : {}),
								...(name === 'template'
									? { popperClass: 'data009-official-template-popper' }
									: {}),
								onSelect: (item: Selection) =>
									selections.value.push({ control: name, item })
							},
							{
								...(name === 'template'
									? {
											suffix: () =>
												h(
													AsamIcon,
													{
														class: 'el-input__icon',
														'data-testid': 'official-template-suffix',
														onClick: (event: MouseEvent) =>
															iconClicks.value.push({
																type: event.type,
																nativeMouse:
																	event instanceof MouseEvent
															})
													},
													{
														default: () =>
															h('svg', { viewBox: '0 0 16 16' }, [
																h('path', {
																	d: 'M2 11l8-8 3 3-8 8H2z',
																	fill: 'currentColor'
																})
															])
													}
												),
											default: ({
												item
											}: {
												item: AsamOption<string, LinkItem>;
											}) => [
												h('div', { class: 'value' }, item.value),
												h('span', { class: 'link' }, item.raw.link)
											]
										}
									: {}),
								...(name === 'loading-ring' ? { loading: circle } : {}),
								...(name === 'loading-dots' ? { loading: dots } : {}),
								...(name === 'header'
									? {
											header: () =>
												h(
													'span',
													{ 'data-testid': 'official-header-content' },
													'页眉内容'
												)
										}
									: {}),
								...(name === 'footer'
									? {
											footer: () =>
												h(
													AsamButton,
													{
														type: 'default',
														link: true,
														size: 'small',
														onClick: clearFooter,
														'data-testid': 'official-footer-clear'
													},
													{ default: () => '清空' }
												)
										}
									: {})
							}
						)
					])
				)
			)
	});
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'data009-autocomplete-official-suggestions' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	for (const release of releases.values()) release();
	app?.unmount();
});
</script>

<template>

<script setup>
import SelectContract from './SelectContract.vue';
import NativeInputContract from './NativeInputContract.vue';
import PopupContract from './PopupContract.vue';
import SourceLifecycleContract from './SourceLifecycleContract.vue';
import PresentationContract from './PresentationContract.vue';
import FormattingContract from './FormattingContract.vue';
import TextCapabilityContract from './TextCapabilityContract.vue';
import ValidationContract from './ValidationContract.vue';
import InputInstanceContract from './InputInstanceContract.vue';
import OfficialInputContract from './OfficialInputContract.vue';
import OfficialLayoutContract from './OfficialLayoutContract.vue';
import OfficialSuggestionContract from './OfficialSuggestionContract.vue';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteNativeDataDemo' });
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import QueryContract from './QueryContract.vue';
const showQueryContract = ref(false);
const showSelectContract = ref(false);
const showNativeInputContract = ref(false);
const showPopupContract = ref(false);
const showSourceLifecycleContract = ref(false);
const showPresentationContract = ref(false);
const showFormattingContract = ref(false);
const showTextCapabilityContract = ref(false);
const showValidationContract = ref(false);
const showInputInstanceContract = ref(false);
const showOfficialInputContract = ref(false);
const showOfficialLayoutContract = ref(false);
const showOfficialSuggestionContract = ref(false);
import {
	AsamCollapse,
	AsamCollapseItem,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref('');
const active = ref(true);
const failure = ref(false);
const requests = ref(0);
const control = ref();
const selected = ref();
const instance = ref({});
const message = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const lastKey = ref('');
const methodResult = ref('');
const events = ref([]);
const showArrow = ref(false);
const offset = ref(16);
function recordKey(event) {
	lastKey.value = event instanceof KeyboardEvent ? event.key : '';
	recordDom('keydown', event);
}
function recordValue(name, value) {
	events.value.push({ name, payload: value });
}
function recordDom(name, event) {
	events.value.push({
		name,
		payload: {
			type: event.type,
			constructor: event.constructor.name,
			trusted: event.isTrusted,
			key: event instanceof KeyboardEvent ? event.key : undefined,
			data: event instanceof CompositionEvent ? event.data : undefined
		}
	});
}
function recordSelect(option) {
	selected.value = option;
	events.value.push({ name: 'select', payload: option });
}
function recordError(error) {
	message.value = error.message;
	events.value.push({ name: 'error', payload: { kind: error.kind, message: error.message } });
}
function recordSuccess(options) {
	message.value = '';
	events.value.push({ name: 'success', payload: options });
}
const members = [
	{ id: 1, label: 'Alpha', value: 'alpha' },

<script setup>
import { computed, nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const scenarios = [
	{ value: 'default', label: '省略配置' },
	...['top', 'top-start', 'top-end', 'bottom', 'bottom-start', 'bottom-end'].map((value) => ({
		value,
		label: value
	})),
	{ value: 'style-object', label: '自定义类与对象样式' },
	{ value: 'style-string', label: '字符串样式' },
	{ value: 'style-array', label: '组合样式' },
	{ value: 'local', label: '就地显示，忽略附加目标' },
	{ value: 'selector', label: '传送到指定选择器' },
	{ value: 'element', label: '传送到实际元素' },
	{ value: 'fit', label: '固定为输入宽度' },
	{ value: 'min', label: '输入宽度作为最小宽度' },
	{ value: 'role', label: '自定义输入角色' }
];
const scenario = ref('default');
const liveRole = ref('searchbox');
const host = ref();
const value = ref('');
const mounted = ref(true);
const generation = ref(0);
const control = ref();
const member = {
	id: 7,
	value: 'alpha',
	name: 'Alpha member with a deliberately long suggestion label for popup width comparison'
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions();
const source = (text) =>
	factory.api({
		api: async (_params, context) => {
			context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			return [member];
		},
		params: { text },
		transform: (items) => items,
		fieldNames: { label: 'name', value: 'value' }
	});
const configuration = computed(() => {
	if (
		['top', 'top-start', 'top-end', 'bottom', 'bottom-start', 'bottom-end'].includes(
			scenario.value
		)
	)
		return {
			placement: scenario.value
		};
	if (scenario.value === 'style-object')
		return {
			popperClass: 'data009-popup-custom',
			popperStyle: { backgroundColor: 'rgb(11, 22, 33)', borderWidth: '3px' }
		};
	if (scenario.value === 'style-string')
		return { popperStyle: 'background-color: rgb(22, 33, 44); border-width: 4px;' };
	if (scenario.value === 'style-array')
		return { popperStyle: [{ backgroundColor: 'rgb(33, 44, 55)' }, { borderWidth: '5px' }] };
	if (scenario.value === 'local')
		return { teleported: false, appendTo: '#autocomplete-popup-host' };
	if (scenario.value === 'selector')
		return { teleported: true, appendTo: '#autocomplete-popup-host' };
	if (scenario.value === 'element') return { teleported: true, appendTo: host.value };
	if (scenario.value === 'fit') return { fitInputWidth: true };
	if (scenario.value === 'min') return { fitInputWidth: false };
	if (scenario.value === 'role') return { containerRole: liveRole.value };
	return {};
});
async function open() {
	liveRole.value = 'searchbox';
	control.value?.close();
	mounted.value = false;
	await nextTick();
	value.value = '';
	generation.value++;
	mounted.value = true;
	await nextTick();
	control.value?.focus();
	await control.value?.getData('');
}
</script>

		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reload(true)">

		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="control?.cancel()">

		</AsamButton>

		</AsamButton>

			持有后续响应
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="hold = false">
			即时后续响应
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="failure = true">
			后续接口失败
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="failure = false">
			恢复接口
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="release(false)">
			完成最早持有响应
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="release(true)">
			拒绝最早持有响应
		</AsamButton>

<script setup>
import { computed, createApp, h, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';

	AsamOption,
	AsamInput,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions,
	provideAsamData

const kind = ref('api');

	activeMode.value === 'omitted' ? undefined : activeMode.value === 'true'
);
const draft = ref('Alpha');
const model = ref('retained-model');

const control = shallowRef();
const calls = ref([]);
const results = ref([]);
const successes = ref([]);
const errors = ref([]);
const hold = ref(false);
const failure = ref(false);

		'abort',
		() => {

		},
		{ once: true }
	);

}
const api = (params, context) =>
	load({ kind: 'api', text: params.text, requestId: context.requestId, aborted: false }, context);
const transformApi = (items) => items;
function isMember(value) {
	return (
		typeof value === 'object' &&
		value !== null &&
		'id' in value &&
		typeof value.id === 'number' &&
		'name' in value &&
		typeof value.name === 'string' &&
		'value' in value &&
		typeof value.value === 'string'
	);
}
function transformRequest(response) {
	if (!Array.isArray(response) || !response.every(isMember))
		throw new Error('invalid member response');

}

	request: async (config, context) => {
		const text = config.params?.text;
		if (typeof text !== 'string')

			{
				kind: 'request',
				text,
				requestId: context.requestId,

const snapshot = computed(() => ({
	kind: kind.value,
	active: active.value ?? 'omitted',
	mounted: mounted.value,
	detachedSuggestions: !mounted.value ? (savedControl?.suggestions ?? []) : undefined,
	draft: draft.value,
	model: model.value,
	calls: calls.value,
	pending: pendingCount.value,
	loading: control.value?.loading ?? false,
	suggestions: control.value?.suggestions ?? [],

	detach();
	await nextTick();

		render: () =>

				ref: control,
				modelValue: model.value,

				triggerOnFocus: false,

				'onUpdate:modelValue': (value) => {

				},
				onSuccess: (items) => {

				onError: (error) => {

}
function detach() {
	if (control.value) savedControl = control.value;

async function reload(force) {

}
async function selectFirst() {
	const item = control.value?.suggestions[0];

function release(reject) {
	const next = deferred.shift();
	pendingCount.value = deferred.length;
	if (!next) return;
	if (reject) next.reject(new Error('held source lifecycle failure'));

<script setup>
import { computed, createApp, h, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';

const icons = ref('omitted');

const api = async (params, context) => {

const transform = (items) => items;

				suffixIcon: icons.value === 'component' ? Suffix : 'Data009Suffix',
				clearIcon: icons.value === 'component' ? Clear : 'Data009Clear'

	...(styleMode.value === 'omitted'
		? {}
		: {
				inputStyle:
					styleMode.value === 'object'
						? { color: '#064e3b', backgroundColor: '#f0fdf4', paddingLeft: '18px' }

<script setup>
import {
	computed,
	createApp,
	h,
	nextTick,
	onBeforeUnmount,
	onMounted,

	ref,
	shallowRef

	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamButton,
	AsamBaseForm,
	AsamFormItem,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions,
	provideAsamData
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const host = ref();
const item = shallowRef();
const fields = reactive({ value: 'Seed' });
const mode = ref('omitted');
const lazy = ref('omitted');

	updates = ref([]),
	changes = ref([]),
	validations = ref([]);
const validateEvents = ref([]);
const rule = {
	trigger: ['change', 'blur'],
	validator: (_rule, value, callback) => {
		validations.value.push(String(value));
		callback(String(value).includes('!') ? new Error('建议值禁止感叹号') : undefined);
	}
};
const api = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return [{ id: 7, name: params.text, value: params.text.toLowerCase() }];
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions();
const transform = (items) => items;
const source = (text) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform,
		fieldNames: { label: 'name', value: 'value' }
	});

	source,
	modelValue: fields.value,
	triggerOnFocus: false,
	debounce: 0,
	ariaLabel: '建议验证输入',
	...(mode.value === 'omitted' ? {} : { validateEvent: mode.value === 'true' }),

const TypedRemote = AsamRemoteAutocomplete;
let app;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	app = createApp({
		render: () =>

				{
					model: fields,
					onValidate: (property, valid, message) =>
						validateEvents.value.push({ property, valid, message })

				() =>
					h(AsamFormItem, { prop: 'value', rules: rule, ref: item }, () =>
						h(TypedRemote, {
							...configuration.value,
							'onUpdate:modelValue': (value) => {
								fields.value = String(value);
								updates.value.push(value);
							},
							onInput: (value) => inputs.value.push(value),
							onChange: (value) => changes.value.push(value)
						})

	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'data009-autocomplete-validation' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
async function reset() {
	fields.value = 'Seed';
	await nextTick();
	await nextTick();
	// Finish the queued blur validation before starting this measurement window.
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
	await nextTick();
	item.value?.clearValidate();
	validations.value = [];
	validateEvents.value = [];
	inputs.value = [];
	updates.value = [];
	changes.value = [];
}
</script>

<script setup>
import { createApp, h, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';

	AsamOption,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions,
	provideAsamData

const host = ref();

const model = ref('Seed');

	updates = ref([]),
	changes = ref([]),
	clears = ref(0);

	'focus',
	'blur',
	'keydown',
	'compositionstart',
	'compositionupdate',
	'compositionend',

		name,

	context.signal.throwIfAborted();

};
const transform = (members) => members;
const source = (text) =>
	factory.api({
		api,

				'onUpdate:modelValue': (value) => {
					model.value = value;
					updates.value.push(value);
				},
				onInput: (value) => inputs.value.push(value),
				onChange: (value) => changes.value.push(value),
				onClear: () => clears.value++,
				onFocus: (event) => record('focus', event),
				onBlur: (event) => record('blur', event),
				onKeydown: (event) => record('keydown', event),
				onCompositionstart: (event) => record('compositionstart', event),
				onCompositionupdate: (event) => record('compositionupdate', event),
				onCompositionend: (event) => record('compositionend', event),
				onMouseenter: (event) => record('mouseenter', event),
				onMouseleave: (event) => record('mouseleave', event)

			'textarea',
			'ref',
			'select',
			'clear',

<script setup>
import { createApp, h, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';

	AsamButton,
	AsamIcon,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions,

	'basic-focus',
	'basic-input',
	'template',
	'remote',
	'loading-ring',
	'loading-dots',
	'header',
	'footer'
];
const links = [
	{ value: 'vue', link: 'https://github.com/vuejs/vue' },
	{ value: 'element', link: 'https://github.com/ElemeFE/element' },
	{ value: 'cooking', link: 'https://github.com/ElemeFE/cooking' },
	{ value: 'mint-ui', link: 'https://github.com/ElemeFE/mint-ui' },
	{ value: 'vuex', link: 'https://github.com/vuejs/vuex' },
	{ value: 'vue-router', link: 'https://github.com/vuejs/vue-router' },
	{ value: 'babel', link: 'https://github.com/babel/babel' }

const host = ref();
const models = ref({
	'basic-focus': '',
	'basic-input': '',
	template: '',
	remote: '',
	'loading-ring': '',
	'loading-dots': '',
	header: '',
	footer: ''
});
const loadingModel = ref('');
const queries = ref([]);
const selections = ref([]);
const iconClicks = ref([]);
const footerClears = ref(0);
const pending = ref([]);
const footer = shallowRef();
const releases = new Map();
const factory = defineAsamOptions();
const TypedRemote = AsamRemoteAutocomplete;
const isLoadingCase = (name) => name === 'loading-ring' || name === 'loading-dots';

const setModel = (name, value) => {
	if (isLoadingCase(name)) loadingModel.value = value;
	else models.value[name] = value;
};
const api = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	const results = links.filter((item) =>
		item.value.toLowerCase().startsWith(params.query.toLowerCase())

	queries.value.push({ ...params, results });
	if (isLoadingCase(params.control)) {
		pending.value.push(params.control);
		try {
			await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => reject(context.signal.reason);

										AsamButton,

											nativeType: 'button',

										},
										{ default: () => '完成官方加载 ' + name }
									)
								]
							: []),
						h(
							TypedRemote,
							{
								...(name === 'footer' ? { ref: footer } : {}),
								modelValue: model(name),
								'onUpdate:modelValue': (value) => setModel(name, value),
								source: caseSource,
								ariaLabel: '官方建议 ' + name,
								placeholder:
									name === 'basic-focus' || name === 'basic-input'
										? '请输入内容'
										: '输入查询内容',
								clearable: name === 'basic-focus' || name === 'basic-input',
								teleported: false,
								debounce: 0,
								...(name === 'basic-input' ? { triggerOnFocus: false } : {}),
								...(name === 'template'
									? { popperClass: 'data009-official-template-popper' }
									: {}),
								onSelect: (item) => selections.value.push({ control: name, item })
							},
							{

													AsamIcon,

														class: 'el-input__icon',
														'data-testid': 'official-template-suffix',

																type: event.type,
																nativeMouse:
																	event instanceof MouseEvent

													},
													{
														default: () =>
															h('svg', { viewBox: '0 0 16 16' }, [
																h('path', {
																	d: 'M2 11l8-8 3 3-8 8H2z',
																	fill: 'currentColor'
																})
															])
													}
												),
											default: ({ item }) => [
												h('div', { class: 'value' }, item.value),
												h('span', { class: 'link' }, item.raw.link)

														size: 'small',

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	for (const release of releases.values()) release();

<style>
.data009-official-suggestion-host {
	margin-block: var(--asam-space-md);

Toggle showArrow among false, true, and undefined. undefined restores the native arrow default. Switch the vertical offset in the same popperOptions object between 0 and 16 to move the popper. These display controls preserve the source query and option data.

The instance controls focus and blur the input, close the suggestions, load all suggestions, highlight the first suggestion or clear the highlight, select the first suggestion, and handle Enter. See the full notes.

This example sets loopNavigation=false, so highlight(-1) clears the current highlight. With native looping enabled, a negative index wraps to the last item. The instance controls open upward to keep the suggestion list visible.

Data sources and overrides ​

source(query) builds an API or request AsamOptionsSource from the current search text. Include the query in the actual request parameters. The source owns options and the query callback. Pass a single source and omit static options and competing callbacks. The local API filters labels and returns the whole list for an empty query.

Create the source with the api or request factory on defineAsamOptions. Both produce remote sources. See the full notes.

The model uses string | number. The select event supplies the selected suggestion or the unmatched payload when enabled. The source takes over fetchSuggestions, remoteSuggestions, and valueKey.

Lifecycle, events, and instance methods ​

active=false pauses requests and retains the last successful data. Use reload({ force: true }) for fresh data and cancel() to cancel the current request. See the full notes.

The base debounce controls query timing. Remote Autocomplete adds reload and cancel to the base instance and uses focus and input to trigger queries. Its public props omit immediate and debounceMs.

A typed query keeps its own request identity. A late response for an old query leaves the latest suggestions untouched, even if its producer ignores cancellation. See the full notes.

The component forwards native input and selection events and adds success and error. Observe loading through the instance and loading slot. See the full notes.

The example logs the actual payloads of model, input, selection, clearing, and request events. See the full notes.

Instance member Behavior
highlightedIndex, activated, loading Live read-only views of the base suggestion index, activation, and loading state.
inputRef, popperRef The base Input and Tooltip instances. They can be undefined before mounting.
suggestions The current rendered suggestion array with the concrete AsamOption<V, I> and its raw type.
focus(), blur(), close(), highlight(index) Control focus, suggestion visibility, and highlighted index.
getData(query) Fetches the given query through this component's source and updates the base suggestions. Returns Promise<void>.
handleSelect(option), handleKeyEnter() Select a full suggestion or handle the current Enter action. Return Promise<void>.
reload({ force? }) Resolves as success with data and fromCache, error, or cancelled. force bypasses optional local cache reads.
cancel() Cancels this consumer's active request and retains its successful snapshot.

Slots and base features ​

The default slot receives { item: AsamOption<V, I> }. prefix, suffix, prepend, append, header, footer, and loading follow the base Autocomplete slots. See the full notes.

Customize the input decorations, suggestion list, and loading state through slots and operate the component through its public instance. See the full notes.

Related base components ​

  • Autocomplete provides the applicable display, interaction, and public API.

Use this page's rules for data sources, models, events, and exposed members, and refer to the linked base components for the features available here. Sizes follow the ASAM base components. Examples use default.

Model modifiers and input state ​

v-model.lazy follows the current base autocomplete. Typing updates modelValue immediately and sends the current query to source. Tabbing away emits change and keeps the committed model. See the full notes.

<template>
	<main class="demo-layout-1">
		<AsamRemoteAutocomplete
			ref="control"
			v-model.lazy="value"
			:source="source"
			:debounce="0"

			:readonly="readonly"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:teleported="false"
			:min="2"
			:max="10"
			:step="2"
			clearable
			aria-label="延迟提交建议"
			@input="inputs.push($event)"
			@change="changes.push($event)"
		>
			<template #default="{ item }">{{ item.label }} · {{ item.raw.id }}</template>
		</AsamRemoteAutocomplete>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" data-testid="blur-target">
			移出输入
		</AsamButton>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="readonly">只读</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<pre data-testid="lazy-model">{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="lazy-calls">{{ JSON.stringify(calls) }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="lazy-events">{{ JSON.stringify({ inputs, changes }) }}</pre>
	</main>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteLazyDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamApiRequest, AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Item {
	id: string;
	label: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
const value = ref<string | number>('seed');
const control = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Item>>();
const readonly = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const inputs = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
const changes = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
const calls = ref<string[]>([]);
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Item[]> = async (query, context) => {
	calls.value.push(query.text);
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return [{ id: query.text, label: query.text, value: query.text }];
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>();
const source = (text: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform: (rows) => rows,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
</script>

Complete consumer of suggestion query parameters ​

The suggestion query controls in native-data add an independent input using the same public Remote Autocomplete. The local query returns Alpha, Beta, a disabled record named Disabled, and Delta. Only enabled normalized suggestions are displayed. See the full notes.

Prop Behavior in the full example
maxSuggestions Filters out disabled options before truncating the normalized result. Switch among 1, 2, and undefined, which restores the default of 100. getData() rejects 0, negatives, fractions, NaN, and Infinity. The example catches the rejection and restores the default.
triggerOnFocus false skips queries on focus and still queries on input. true and undefined query the current text on focus.
highlightFirstItem true highlights the first suggestion after loading. false and undefined leave the initial highlight unset.
loopNavigation true and undefined wrap negative indices to the last item in an active popper. false reserves -1 for clearing the highlight.
hideLoading true hides the loading content. false and undefined show the loading slot. The instance state and pending local request remain the same.
debounce Omitted or undefined inherits the native 300ms default and batches rapid input. Use 0 to query immediately with the current text or 180ms to batch rapid input. This is the base control's query debounce.

Hold and release the local request to observe loading and then complete that same operation. The limit, keyboard, and loading-display controls preserve returned entities and source raw and run locally. Both language variants use the same operations.

inputRef and popperRef are live, read-only optional instance references. Turn off the demo input and the retained public instance reports both references as absent. Turn it back on to get a new instance. Check that each reference exists before using its nested API.

selectWhenUnmatched set to false or omitted emits no select when no suggestion matches. In historical package 56682, enabling it caused a native unmatched payload with only { value: currentModel }, without a source entity's label or raw. The historical package's declaration disagreed with that payload.

The public select event accepts a full matched suggestion or { value: string | number } for unmatched selection. See the full notes.

Historical package 56682 retains evidence of the mismatch between its declaration and unmatched payload. Closing the four historical failures requires actual consumption and independent verification of the later package.

The selection payload controls in native-data cover six matching sources and default, false, and true unmatched settings for string and numeric models. Press Enter to exercise the actual keyboard path. See the full notes.

Native input props and model ​

The native input section of native-data uses its own local API and passes draft input to the actual source parameters. Input stays in the demo. Toggle between supplying and omitting the props to inspect the model, input events, and query log. If the popper flips above the input, close it with Escape before using the toolbar.

Props Behavior in the full example
modelValue Setting the model externally to seed or 42 displays the corresponding value. Editing commits a string via native input and preserves input, update:modelValue, and the query.
id, ariaLabel, tabindex, form, name Passed to the actual input or textarea. An explicit form associates an independent form. Omitting it removes that association. The native input generates its ID when omitted, and tabindex defaults to 0.
autocomplete, inputmode, placeholder The configured values are on, search, and “Input contract.” Omitting them restores off, removes inputmode, and restores ASAM's “Please input” placeholder.
minlength, maxlength Minimum 2 and maximum 8. Typing one character produces native tooShort. The input retains at most eight characters. Omitting the props removes both limits.
readonly, disabled Read-only blocks editing and retains the model. Disabled also blocks native input interaction. Turning them off restores editing with the existing model.
type, rows, resize text and password retain a string model. The textarea uses four rows and resize="none". Omitting rows restores the native two rows. The fresh number-input branch tests number on an independent mount.
min, max, step A text input receives the attributes without numeric clamping. The fresh number input uses 2, 10, and 2. Entering 3 yields stepMismatch, 1 yields rangeUnderflow, 12 yields rangeOverflow, and 4 is valid.
autofocus Sets the real autofocus attribute. The initial input in a new document receives focus when browser conditions allow. Omitting it lets remounting preserve existing focus. Subsequent mounts remain subject to browser focus rules.

In the pinned version, editing after a live switch from text or password to number can trigger a native selection-range error. See the full notes.

Omitting validateEvent passes undefined to the base component and enables its default participation in validation. Explicit false disables it. See the full notes.

The input composition example configures the clear icon, prefix, suffix, and attached controls. See the full notes.

The count examples cover the official Array.from code-point callback, UTF-16 code units, and Intl.Segmenter graphemes. The code-point example uses separate emoji and the grapheme case also includes a ZWJ family emoji. Both callback modes run with text inputs and textareas and with inside and outside counters. Code-point and grapheme counts use distinct units.

Two AsamPassword instances demonstrate the default and custom icons. They share one controlled model and keep independent visibility states, so editing either instance updates the value in the other.

The native input, disabled, formatting, and multiline cases have their own examples. See the full notes.

source(query) is the sole suggestion source. The public types exclude fetchSuggestions, including callback and array forms, valueKey, and their kebab-case equivalents. In JavaScript, supplying these props on initialization throws a config error before any request. See the full notes.

Official input layouts. The with-icon, mixed-input, and various-size branches cover omitted default, large, and small sizes without an icon and with prefix or suffix icons. The example also covers ASAM's big size. See the full notes.

Each official layout uses a separately mounted control. Switching configurations remounts the input while preserving the controlled model and provider. Within a configuration, size, selection, and button interactions keep the same suggestion input. A separate native Input experiment with slots added or removed on the same instance retained the old suffix visibility. This example exercises the independently mounted branches.

The suggestion variants demonstrate focus triggers, filtering, templates, remote queries, and selection. See the full notes.

Input prop index. The native 2.14.7 Autocomplete link to Input lists 35 original props. See the full notes.

Local request error slot ​

The optional error slot runs only when the current request has an error. It receives a read-only { error, stale, retry } scope. See the full notes.

Call retry() without arguments. It returns the forced reload Promise and follows the same cancellation and unmount behavior. See the full notes.

Providing the slot replaces the default local error region, including when the slot renders empty content. With the slot omitted, the component displays its error message, stale-data hint, and retry button. The slot requires a current error. empty, loading, and other base slots keep their original scopes.

In the complete TypeScript and JavaScript example, trigger a failure and await the slot's retry() result. After a success, trigger a refresh failure to see the existing result and model retained. Each mount creates an isolated child app with a local provider.

vue
<template><div ref="host" /></template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteDemoLocalErrorExample' });
import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createTransport } from './transport.js';
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	const transport = createTransport();
	app = createApp(Child, { transport });
	provideAsamData(app, transport.provider, { scope: 'AsamRemoteAutocomplete-local-error' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
</script>
