<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteAutocomplete, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose, AsamRemoteAutocompleteSlots } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { Transport, Item } from './transport.js';

const props = defineProps<{ readonly transport: Transport }>();
const transport = props.transport;
const value = ref<string>('');
const control = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Item>>();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const dataSource = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>().api({
	api: transport.api,
	params: undefined,
	transform: (rows) => rows,
	fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
});
const source = () => dataSource;
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(
	retry: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamRemoteAutocompleteSlots<string, Item>['error']>>[0]['retry']
) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

ts
import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Item {
	readonly id: number;
	readonly value: string;
	readonly label: string;
}
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		] satisfies readonly Item[];
	};
	const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (
				_type: string,
				context: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDataProvider['dict']>['get']>[1]
			) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}
export type Transport = ReturnType<typeof createTransport>;

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteAutocomplete, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const props = defineProps({ transport: { type: Object, required: true } });
const transport = props.transport;
const value = ref('');
const control = ref();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const dataSource = defineAsamOptions().api({ api: transport.api, params: undefined });
const source = () => dataSource;
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(retry) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

import { ref } from 'vue';
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		];
	};
	const provider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (_type, context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}

Local and global poppers ​

The basic example uses default global mounting. The local mounting example explicitly configures teleported or appendTo. Open the popper and inspect its container. Mount location is independent of the model and request protocol.

Additional usage notes ​

Popper, complete suggestions, and error recovery ​

popperOptions and showArrow configure the actual suggestion popper. The full example hides the arrow, sets an offset, and uses header, footer, loading, and the default suggestion slot. Selecting a suggestion puts its label into the input model. select emits the normalized option including its original raw member, and the option's value can differ from the text. Enable the simulated failure and force a reload to observe stale data, then disable the failure and reload to recover.

Popper, complete suggestions, and error recovery ​

The controls focus, blur, close, load all suggestions, highlight the first item or clear the highlight, select the first item, and handle Enter. getData('') sends an empty query through the source and updates the full suggestion list. handleSelect() takes a real suggestion and commits its label. The event keeps value and raw. Highlight the first option and call handleKeyEnter() to commit it. Read the live highlightedIndex, activated, loading, and suggestions from the instance-state control. The controls sit in the append slot and prevent mouse-down focus changes so requests and highlights stay visible. blur() and close() remain available independently.

Data sources and overrides ​

Build the source through defineAsamOptions.api or defineAsamOptions.request. Configure mapping, synchronous transform, and optional cache in the factory. The component accepts only source(query). Supplying options, fetchSuggestions, remoteSuggestions, valueKey, api, request, dataSource, dictType, or a competing source is a configuration error for JavaScript consumers as well.

Lifecycle, events, and instance methods ​

active=false pauses requests and retains the last successful data. Use reload({ force: true }) for fresh data and cancel() to cancel the current request. success emits a normalized option array. error emits an AsamDataError. A failed refresh marks the last successful data stale. Handle the reload result by its status of success, error, or cancelled.

Lifecycle, events, and instance methods ​

Each request retains its query identity. Late responses from an old query leave the current data untouched, even when the producer ignores cancellation. A failure retains the previous successful suggestions and marks them stale. A first failure leaves suggestions empty. A successful reload() synchronizes visible suggestions using the same result. cancel() preserves successful suggestions and discards late results. Scope and epoch invalidation follow provider isolation rules.

Slots and base features ​

default receives { item: AsamOption<V, I> }. prefix, suffix, prepend, append, header, footer, and loading use the base Autocomplete slot contract. Suggestions exclude disabled options and respect the positive-integer maxSuggestions limit. The default rendering shows each option's label.

Model modifiers and input state ​

v-model.lazy follows the base autocomplete. Input immediately updates modelValue and sends the query to source. Tabbing away emits change with the previously committed value still in the model. Selecting a suggestion immediately commits its label. The request log, model, and input and change events are displayed together so you can type and press Tab to compare their order. Read-only and disabled prevent editing. min, max, and step pass to the real input. This text input does not perform numeric range validation. All APIs in the example are local.

Complete consumer of suggestion query parameters ​

The suggestion query controls in native-data use a separate input on the same public Remote Autocomplete entry. The local source returns Alpha, Beta, disabled Disabled, and Delta and displays the enabled normalized options. The original event, popper, and instance controls remain available. The new instance controls open above the input from the actual append slot. Clicks on ordinary external controls close suggestions under native behavior, so use the slot controls to observe highlights.

Complete consumer of suggestion query parameters ​

select emits a full matched suggestion or { value: string | number }. With selectWhenUnmatched=true, Enter on an empty suggestion list can emit the value-only object. Omitted or false suppresses that selection. Narrow with 'raw' in item before accessing raw or label. Matched source objects, the default slot's item, suggestions, handleSelect() arguments, and success retain full suggestions.

Complete consumer of suggestion query parameters ​

The selection payload controls in native-data cover six matching sources and string and numeric unmatched input with default, false, and true settings and actual Enter handling. A matched payload is the same complete object held in suggestions. Remote normalization copies and freezes the source business data, and the matched option shares its raw reference with the success payload. Host records remain mutable. The default slot reads the full item. Narrow unmatched events before accessing raw.

Native input props and model ​

Native Autocomplete 2.14.7 sets the input role to textbox during onMounted, so initial containerRole="searchbox" is overwritten on mount. Changing the mounted input role to group updates its attribute while the outer autocomplete stays a combobox. Input and Autocomplete have separate role lifecycle behavior.

Local request error slot ​

The optional error slot runs only while the current request has an error. It receives a read-only { error, stale, retry } scope. The public events include update:modelValue, input, change, select, clear, focus, blur, compositionstart, compositionupdate, compositionend, mouseenter, mouseleave, and keydown, plus success and error. Local request error slot ​

Call retry() without arguments. The Promise from reload({ force: true }) resolves to the success, error, or cancelled branch of AsamReloadResult<readonly AsamOption<V, I>[]>. Retrying honors active, the current source, cancellation, and unmount and preserves the model. On success it also waits for the native suggestion list to refresh using the same result.

// AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps
type PublicContract<V extends AsamValue = AsamValue, I extends object = AsamRecord> = {
	readonly "source": (query: string) => AsamOptionsSource<V, I, "api" | "request">;
	readonly "active"?: boolean | undefined;

	readonly "placement"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["placement"];
	readonly "popperOptions"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["popperOptions"];
	readonly "showArrow"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "appendTo"?: string | HTMLElement | undefined;
	readonly "teleported"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "disabled"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "tabindex"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "size"?: AsamControlSize | undefined;
	readonly "type"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["type"];
	readonly "name"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "max"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "modelValue"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "formatter"?: ((value: string) => string) | undefined;
	readonly "rows"?: number | undefined;
	readonly "resize"?: "horizontal" | "vertical" | "none" | "both" | undefined;
	readonly "min"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "autofocus"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "validateEvent"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "clearable"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "step"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "clearIcon"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["clearIcon"];
	readonly "prefixIcon"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["prefixIcon"];
	readonly "readonly"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "placeholder"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "autocomplete"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "debounce"?: number | undefined;
	readonly "fitInputWidth"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "suffixIcon"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["suffixIcon"];
	readonly "inputStyle"?: import("vue").StyleValue;
	readonly "inputmode"?: "text" | "email" | "search" | "tel" | "url" | "none" | "numeric" | "decimal" | undefined;
	readonly "modelModifiers"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["modelModifiers"];

	readonly "minlength"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "autosize"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["autosize"];
